name: How do I choose between a Level 4 and Level 5 drywall finish?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a Level 4 and Level 5 drywall finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Level 4 finish applies three coats of compound over taped joints and fasteners, sanded smooth for standard texture or flat paints. A Level 5 finish adds a full skim coat of joint compound across the entire drywall surface. This extra layer eliminates minute texture differences between the paper facing and the mudded joints. Choose Level 5 when walls face critical lighting, large windows, or when applying gloss or semi-gloss paints that otherwise reveal subtle joint banding under direct light.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose Level 4 for standard textures and matte paint. Choose Level 5 for high-gloss paint, smooth walls, or areas with harsh, direct lighting.
